title.en: Northeast India and the Western Ghats

text.en: Shanti's parents were busy planning the summer holiday. Shanti asked, 'Could we go to more places instead of staying in one?' Appa and Amma smiled and said they had big plans - a trip to a few different places, starting from the southernmost tip of India. Shanti thought it was Kanyakumari, but it is Indira Point in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Shanti sees bridges made of tree roots that have grown strong enough to walk on. We just have to look after them.

Northeast India has seven states called the Seven Sisters, along with Sikkim. It is a land of green hills and great traditions where culture and nature grow together.
Bhut Jolokia, or ghost pepper, grows here, is one of the hottest chillies in the world, and is used in pickles and to keep elephants away from crops.
Women teach children to protect the nests of the Hargila bird, the Greater Adjutant Stork, and its numbers have grown with everyone's help.
Activity: choose an animal or bird near you that needs protection and make a protection plan, and make a bird nest from twigs, leaves and cotton.
The living root bridges are made from roots of trees growing across streams.
The Western Ghats are home to animals like the lion-tailed macaque, found only here. Several rivers of India begin in these hills.
Many plants there are used in traditional medicine, and tribal communities depend on the forest for food, medicine and livelihood.
Researchers with schools and farmers recorded over 200 types of mangoes in the Western Ghats and are now looking at jackfruit and jamun.
The Kailasanatha Temple in Ellora, Maharashtra, is the world's largest building carved from a single rock.
India's Chandrayaan-3 landed on the lunar south pole of the Moon for the first time.
The trip begins at the southernmost tip of India, Indira Point, part of the long chain of islands called the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
An island is land surrounded by water on all sides. There are over a thousand islands in the seas around India that are part of the country.
Shanti's family began in Sri Vijaya Puram, the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, and Rani, their local guide, took them through the forest.
Many trees there are found only on these islands. Big roots grow out of the bottom of the tree and spread out wide to support it. You can see this with a paper roll: it stands better with paper triangles stuck around its base, just as roots support the tree.
Birds like the Andaman wood pigeon and the Andaman hornbill are found only on these islands, which makes the forests special and important to protect.
Before the ferry ride to a nearby island, everyone must wear a life jacket even if they can swim, because it keeps you afloat if you fall into the water.

problem.en: Name three special things about the Western Ghats.

text.en: Lion-tailed macaques are found only here.
Many rivers begin here.
Many medicinal plants grow here.

prompt.en: What makes the Northeast and Western Ghats special?

commonMisconceptions.en: Thinking they are the same as other regions

points.en: Northeast India is the Seven Sisters and Sikkim.
The Western Ghats have rare animals, plants and rivers.
